title: Metrics on triangulated categories and their enhancements
summary: In this paper we investigate the uniqueness of enhancements of the natural subcategories of weakly approximable triangulated categories. The main idea is to enhance at the level of $\infty$-categories the recently developed theory of excellent metrics. The applications of our results include a vast generalization of the known results about the (strong) uniqueness of enhancements in the linear and nonlinear setting, providing positive answers to some open questions.
